name: Padstow Obby Oss

attributes.attribute: takes place in Padstow on May 1
linked to old Celtic horse rituals

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Padstow Obby Oss is a Cornish ritual. It happens in the small port town of Padstow on Beltane morning, May 1. The ceremony marks the arrival of spring on the old Celtic A hobbyhorse leads the celebration. The festival connects to Celtic horse rites from olden times.

okr.objective: Describe the Padstow Obby Oss spring ritual.
key_results: The ceremony runs in Padstow on Beltane morning, May 1.
A hobby horse leads the celebration of spring.
The ritual links to old Celtic horse ceremonies.
